subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Marine Insurance and Exploration
description: A quick win: understand Marine Insurance and Exploration.

hook.text: Without marine insurance, the Age of Exploration might never have happened. Ships cost too much to lose.

buildup.text: Italian merchants in the 1300s created formal contracts covering cargoes on Mediterranean voyages.

discovery.text: Risk was spread across many investors. No one person bore the full cost of a shipwreck.

twist.text: Insurance made risk affordable. Merchants attempted voyages they'd never fund alone.

climax.text: Global trade expanded because insurance made bold ventures financially survivable.

punchline.text: Insurance funded exploration. Risk built empires.

quiz.question: How did marine insurance help exploration?
options: It spread risk, making bold voyages financially survivable
It was only for royal-sponsored expeditions
